build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with parameterized target position, radius, buffer, and angle
add_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle with configurable angle, scale, and position in the scene
add_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball with configurable scale and center position on the ramp
update_task_relationship: define the task goal by setting body1 and body2 with a touching spatial relationship
skip_template_params: raise SkipTemplateParams when the ball width exceeds the target segment width
